trigger: check-docs-drift --touch d460f7618 HEAD reports the dex rule: dex_* sources changed with no coupled doc touched
classification_rationale: a coupled-doc touch is a required doc under the six-item list only when a shipped behaviour changes; none does (the scope is not caller-reachable until the API row), so the exempt route is the accurate one (docs-writer derives INFO, compliance SHOULD)
summary: CI's doc-coupling touch rule needs a coupled edit or an exempt line; every current caller gets the windows scope with unchanged output.
resolved by the `doc-coupling-exempt: dex - ...` line carried in the PR body (docs land with the change that exposes the scope); verified by check-docs-drift --touch with the body file at PR creation

summary: The fleet normaliser (exact darwin/macos) is weaker than the store writer (starts_with): a non-shipped spelling would understate the macos population (a visible null or withheld score, never a wrong number).
to be fixed with the API row that exposes the macos scope (use dex_perf_os_from_session for the fleet os); issue number awaits Alex's go

trigger: a future direct caller of build_dex_apps_model or dex_app_stability_checked passes an empty or unvalidated token
classification_rationale: fail-closed currently rests on the single front door LocalDexApi::apps; same permission, aggregate only, floor 1, no agent_id
summary: The builder trusts a normalized token; an empty token means every platform at the store seam (precedent: dex_crash_summary platform empty).
accepted as a documented single-front-door design; add a validation when a second caller appears (the API row); issue number awaits Alex's go

trigger: a future API handler (the deferred API row) passes an unknown scope token

summary: invalid_scope has no log line (score_policy_unavailable has a throttle) and would surface as 503 with retry.
carried to the API row: validate the scope at the handler and answer 400; issue number awaits Alex's go

accepted: the existing literal goldens (population_basis windows_online) and the unchanged Windows-only [pg] case are the pre-change anchors; no extra test needed
